name: Apex Capital
description: Apex Capital is a boutique commercial real estate brokerage and acquisitions firm based in Southern California. We help commercial property owners (multifamily, retail strips, small office, light industrial) decide whether to sell, refinance, or hold, and we connect investors with off-market acquisition opportunities. The initial valuation and discovery conversation is free.
icps: SELLER, Property owners and sponsors weighing sell, refi, or hold on aging or underperforming assets
BUYER, Real estate investment groups and family offices sourcing off-market acquisitions
BUYER, Property management firms with portfolio owners exploring repositioning or disposition
SELLER + BUYER, Multi-asset sponsors who are both pruning the portfolio and looking for the next deal
ownerRole: Managing Partner / Principal / Asset Manager / Director of Acquisitions / Owner
productOrServiceSummary: Four core service lines: (1) Valuation Desk, a free initial property valuation and decision worksheet (sell vs refi vs hold); (2) Off-Market Marketplace, investors search pre-listing inventory across the Apex Capital network; (3) Disposition Services, a managed off-market sale for owners who want to test the market without a public listing; (4) Acquisition Sourcing, buy-side off-market sourcing for investors with a defined buy box. Discovery call is 15-20 minutes, free.
salesMotion: Outbound discovery-booking via AI voice. Seller pitch to property owners, asset managers, and sponsors (evaluate sell vs refi vs hold without listing publicly). Buyer pitch to acquisitions directors, investment principals, and family offices (off-market deal flow that matches the buy box). Multi-asset sponsors get both angles. Goal every call: book a 15-20 min discovery call.
pricingNote: Initial valuation and discovery call are free. Do not discuss commissions, fee splits, or transaction economics on calls, defer to the discovery conversation.
